questions.question: In 2025, researchers from which institutions developed the District Flood Severity Index in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (IIT Delhi and IIT Gandhinagar) है।

questions.question: The most liquid forms of money available for immediate use in transactions within the economy is known as ______________.
Bhadravati and Vijayanagar from Karnataka are famous for which of the following industries?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Iron and steel plants) है।

questions.question: Who among the following personalities wrote the ‘Gita Govinda’ in the 12th century?
Before 1950, Union Public Service Commission was named as:
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Federal Public Service Commission) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about stupas during the Post-Mauryan period is correct?
options: Stupas in south India from this period are all intact and well-preserved.
Stupas at Bharhut and Sanchi were originally constructed during the Gupta Empire.
The Bharhut stupa is primarily known for its wooden railings.
The Amravati stupa reached its final form in second century AD.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The Amravati stupa reached its final form in second century AD.) है।

questions.question: The Bhadla Solar Park is associated with which state?
According to the report of the Technical Group on Population Projections 2011-2036 for India and States, what percentage of India's population was in the working age group i.e. 15-59 years in 2011?
How many total medals did India secure at the Asian Under-19 & Under-22 Boxing Championships 2025?
Which Article of the Indian Constitution states that the President is an integral part of the Union Parliament?
Who among the following is the author of the famous Tamil major text 'Silappadikaram' written in the 5th-6th century?
Which of the following is the most important function of a central bank?
options: Issuing currency notes and controlling the supply of money in the economy
Collecting taxes and formulating the annual budget of the government
Managing the day-to-day operations of commercial banks
Providing loans directly to farmers, small businesses, and households
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Issuing currency notes and controlling the supply of money in the economy) है।

questions.question: When an acid reacts with a metal, hydrogen gas gets evolved along with _________________.

questions.question: In which of the following years was the Vijayanagara Empire founded?

Europasaurus holgeri from Lower Saxony in Germany
Patagotitan mayorum from Patagonia in Argentina
Jinchuanloong niedu from Gansu province in China
